import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='sepal_length',
    y='sepal_width',
    hue='species',
    palette='viridis',
    s=100, # Adjust marker size for better visibility
    alpha=0.8 # Add some transparency
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Sepal Length vs. Sepal Width by Iris Species', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement
plt.legend(title='Species', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/legend from being cut off
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='sepal_length',
    y='sepal_width',
    hue='species',
    palette='viridis',
    s=100, # Adjust marker size for better visibility
    alpha=0.8 # Add some transparency
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Sepal Length vs. Sepal Width by Iris Species', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement
plt.legend(title='Species', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/legend from being cut off
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
